# High Point Realty & Auction

> Kentucky's premier real estate and auction company. Serving Central and Eastern Kentucky with integrity.

## About

High Point Realty & Auction is a full-service real estate and auction firm based in Richmond, Kentucky. We specialize in residential and commercial real estate sales as well as professional auction services across Central and Eastern Kentucky.

## Services

- **Real Estate Sales**: Buyer and seller representation for residential and commercial properties
- **Auction Services**: Onsite and online auctions for real property and personal property

## Service Area

Madison, Estill, Rockcastle, Jackson, Lee, and Breathitt counties in Kentucky, and surrounding areas.
